analytical_sql_capability.verdict: all requested aggregate/window/relational/time capabilities are SUPPORTED_BUILTIN on core PostgreSQL 18.1

blocking_constraints: compiler contract admits only count|ratio, day|month, single area|team dimension
AggregateContract requires formula_version/release_id/snapshot_id/checkpoint/data_as_of (and numerator/denominator) which neither Gold table has
gateway envelope: 1 SELECT, <=5 CTEs, depth<=5, <=200 rows, <=1MB, cost<=500000, plan rows<=100000

runtime_db_identity.audit_identity: postgres (SUPERUSER) - provenance upper bound, NOT the product identity

roles.agent_reader: NOLOGIN, inherits SELECT on 27 public relations
roles.agent_reader_user: LOGIN, member of agent_reader, SELECT on 9 ai_views

runtime_db_identity.readonly_enforced_by: SELECT-only privileges, not by a transaction-read-only GUC

sandbox_implication.meaning: a sandbox is useful only for bounded advanced/ML jobs; the evidence does NOT justify a general arbitrary-code sandbox
rationale: all 16 requested analytical families are native SQL with zero extensions
no untrusted procedural language is installed and plpython3u is not even available
no relation is VERY_LARGE; largest is 2.1GB / 1.58M rows
residual app-side needs are five enumerable bounded categories
sandbox_implication.not_yes_because: the requested business computation does not fundamentally require arbitrary code
qualifications: ultimate sandbox scope is a product decision about forecast/ML ambition, not a DB question
the repo already contains codeact_engine and dynamic_calc agents; the question addressed is whether the data/SQL layer demands one

max_input_shape.preferred: aggregated to (metric, time bucket, dimension) - the gold_metric_result shape
max_input_shape.caps: must come from a single gateway-admitted SELECT: <=200 rows, <=1MB

sql_compiler: (after extension) weighted averages, MoM/YoY, rolling/cumulative windows, percentiles, stddev/variance, correlation, regression
ml_forecast_runtime: forecast intervals + uncertainty notice; advisory only, never Gold fact

architectural_flag.finding: the model-authored freeform SQL path is still alive in the current repo while the deterministic typed pipeline is dormant
architectural_flag.root_cause: src/nl2sql/container.py:119-123 wires no context_resolver/query_plan_provider/plan_executor so typed_pipeline_enabled=False; after_route engine.py:826-831
architectural_flag.consequence: QueryGateway currently GOVERNS model-authored SQL rather than replacing it; pushed-down calculation must travel the compiled path
